use_when: Use type listing for something people can open or book: a stay, an experience, or a trip, with a photo, a title, one details line and the price.
Turn on ShowTag for a status on the photo, such as "Confirmed", and ShowAction for a text action such as "View"; turn ShowRating off when there are no reviews yet.
Use type stat in the back office for one key number, such as "Active admins 27", in a row of 3 to 5 tiles at the top of a page.
Keep every card in a grid the same width and photo ratio, so titles and prices line up.
One line each for title and details: they cut off with … rather than wrap.
Make the whole listing card clickable, and keep the Action for a second, smaller step.

dont_use_when.when: For rows of data people compare or sort: use a Table.
To choose one option in a form: use Radiocard.
For a stat that needs a chart or several numbers: use a content panel, not a stat tile.

variant_intent.listing: something people can open or book: a stay, an experience, or a trip, with a photo, a title, one details line and the price
variant_intent.stat: a back office KPI tile: one key number, in a row of 3 to 5 tiles at the top of a page

a11y.fact: The photo is Horizon's Image component, a native , and imageAlt (default empty, so decorative) is passed to its alt.

The card is a plain
with no role; title, details and price are

text, so they read in DOM order. Caller-supplied attributes (onClick, role, aria-*) are spread onto the container.
